Sam: Quick alert 13:37 UTC — a subset of onboarding uploads failed to index between 13:20-13:35 UTC. I collected the initial affected list and want CS to prepare comms. Priya, can you prioritize renewals?

Priya (CS): Thanks Sam. Can you paste the tenant IDs? I'll pull renewal dates and flag high-touch.

Sam: Affected summary: RetailLab-77 (renewal in 6 days), StarterTrial-103, UniPilot-11, HealthProto-2. Failure mode: embedding write errors returning 503 during that window.

Riley (SRE): We rolled a retry job and temporary write-backoff was disabled incorrectly during a recent config flip. Fix deployed at 13:41 UTC, queue processing now. Root cause: config propagation race; not a model regression.

deploy-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-099, job retry/queue-drain in progress.

Priya (CS): For RetailLab-77 (high risk) we'll send a tailored note and offer 1:1 enablement + 30% discount for next invoice. For trials: 60-min recovery session + 5% credit. Sam please include a short customer-facing sentence that avoids ops jargon.

Ethan (AE): RetailLab-77 accepts credits but needs an assurance on SLA. Offer should include a follow-up lane with named SRE contact and a 30-min technical sync. I'll join the outreach.

Priya (CS): Draft outbound (concise): "Hi <Name>, we experienced intermittent indexing delays between 13:20-13:35 UTC that may have affected some uploads. We've retried pending items and are monitoring; most items should complete within the hour. We're sorry — we'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute recovery session and a one-time 5% credit. If you'd like priority help, reply and we'll fast-track manual re-ingest."

Priya (CS): High-touch RetailLab-77 draft: "Hi <Name>, apologies for the disruption. We've prioritized your uploads, added a named SRE contact for follow-up, and would like to offer a 30% invoice credit or one month of elevated support. Please let us know which you prefer and a good time for a 30-min technical sync."

Sam: Affirmative on wording. Finance tag: "incident-credit-1832123456" for tracking.

Riley (SRE): Queue is draining; retries showing steady success. We'll attach logs for manual follow-ups. Recommend CS avoid internal detail like 'config propagation race' in external messages.

Priya (CS): Agreed. I'll send high-touch to RetailLab-77 now, and a broadcast to trials in 20m after we confirm queue drain. We'll log responses in the CS tracker and pull notes into the RCA.

Ethan (AE): I'll be on the RetailLab thread and join the technical sync. Please CC me on the outreach.

Sam: Thanks all. I'll update execs and ops with a 3-line summary by EOD. :thumbsup:
